notes:
Summary: Aperture builds a personalization/reranking layer for high-traffic e-commerce sites. Very latency- and cost-sensitive — business metric: page conversion uplift while keeping per-request cost below internal target.

Key requirements: p95 latency under 40ms end-to-end for ranking and personalization calls; sustain 8k-12k req/s typical with spikes to 20k; graceful degradation to smaller models during peak; audit logs + KMS for keys; VPC peering for private traffic.

From CTO (Paraphrase): "We need predictable latency — spikes kill conversion. If p95 slips above ~40ms we see measurable drop in add-to-cart. Cost target is tight; quantization + batching must actually reduce unit cost without hurting quality."

Optimization interest: explicit ask for Redwood Optimize playbook — batching strategy per route, prefix/KV caching for repeat session tokens, recommended quantization profiles (int8 / awq) for Llama-family 13B and fallback 7B, and automated benchmarking harness we can run against our traffic shape. Also want token-level cost breakdown and per-route SLO reporting in Console.

POC notes: Sent synthetic workload script (github link in drive). SE request: compare 13B int8 vs 7B int4 fallback on latency/cost/quality for same prompts. Order of testing: baseline (no batching), continuous batching (1–4 request windows), aggressive batching for non-latency-critical routes, KV prefix cache warm vs cold.

Stated risks/blockers: internal security wants SOC2 report and encryption at rest checks; network needs VPC peering and static egress IPs for allow-listing; procurement needs estimated ARR band for sign-off.

Short action items (from AE/SE): 1) Run Redwood perf benchmark (3-day) with our S3 traffic; 2) deliver quantization recommendations + quality delta matrix; 3) provide VPC peering checklist and sample IAM/KMS config; 4) price model for Dedicated vs Hosted with burst policy.
throughput_targets: steady 8k-12k req/s, spikes to 20k req/s for flash sales
model_preferences: Prefer open models; baseline Llama2-13B quantized (int8/awq), fallback 7B quantized for severe load. Need model-variant routing and automatic fallback policies.
budget_notes: Cost-sensitive: target <$0.0015 per request for average rerank call; willing to pay premium for guaranteed p95 SLOs but want clear unit economics and Optimize suggestions.
additional_comments: Interested in automated benchmark artifacts (latency histograms, token-cost heatmaps), can provide sample traffic + golden prompts. Want canary rollout support for model updates and quick rollback on regressions.
